title: Overfitting observed on class-conditional ImageNet 64x64
description: Despite ImageNet being a much larger and more diverse dataset, overfitting was surprisingly observed on class-conditional ImageNet 64x64, with FID worsening over training.
canonical_description: Generative model overfits even on large-scale diverse datasets during extended training

evidence.quote: Like on CIFAR-10, we surprisingly observed overfitting on class-conditional ImageNet $64 \times 64$, despite it being a much larger and more diverse dataset.
